<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak at m/z 100.0524 corresponds to the protonated molecule [M+H]+. Subtracting the proton mass (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈99.045 Da. The isotopic pattern (M+1 ≈5.6 % of M) indicates about five carbon atoms (≈5 × 1.1 %). A composition of C₅H₇O₂ has a calculated monoisotopic mass of 99.0446 Da, matching the observed value within <1 mDa. Therefore the molecular formula is C₅H₇O₂.</thought>
<final_answer>C5H7O2</final_answer>
